title: Federal Reserve payment-system mandate map — what “safe and efficient” means
adds: It is a central function ('fostering payment and settlement system safety and efficiency', plus accessibility) but not a third statutory mandate parallel to FRA §2A; it is assembled from operate, access, intraday liquidity, regulate, supervise/oversee and catalyze powers. 'The responsibility is real, but the power is distributed and tool-specific'; ask which actor controls access, operation, liquidity, finality, records, loss and cost for the exact rail and clock.
